title: Why Static CMS Architecture is Superior for 2026
excerpt: Explore why file-based static publishing outperforms traditional monolithic CMS platforms in speed, security, and scalability.

blocks.text: Traditional CMS platforms run a full relational database query on every HTTP request. This creates security vulnerabilities, slows down page render time, and creates operational bottlenecks.
The fastest database query is the one you never execute.
By keeping content in structured JSON files with atomic rename operations, we gain easy version control, zero database licensing fees, and instant rollback capability.
